frames.subtitle: Back in 2017...
we had no idea how broken travel really was...
but we knew there had to be a better way to book hotels.
S M B's were booking on consumer sites with their personal cards,
managing spreadsheets,
pulling out their hair.
Behind the scenes, we noticed that generic APIs weren't cutting it.
So we went direct. . . Rooftop contracts. . . Exclusive rates.
Partner Hub became a decade of supply relationships no one can copy.
We also offered growing companies a line of credit, with Direct Bill.
Then Groups...
Flights.
Cars.
Spaces.
Engine X.
Each layer built on the one before....
We chose to do the hard things.
That's become the reason nobody can catch us today.
Now we're stepping into the world where anyone can build their own products with AI and this is when the momentum really picks up.
Our API is available to anyone building a travel product...
even our competitors are now our customers. We didn't set out to build infrastructure, we had no choice. and...
This is our Amazon to AWS moment.
Everything we built for ourselves is now available to everyone.
Engine will still be Engine. S M B's still our customer.
Every problem we solve for them, it solves it for 10x more businesses and travelers.
This isn't a temporary thing. We're not chasing the AI wave.
We are the foundation it runs on.
Every new AI agent, every new travel platform that emerges needs exactly what we spent a decade building.
We want everyone to build on Engine.
Because the more products built on Engine, the stronger we get.
Engine is powering the future of travel.
And we live in a world where every booking, on any platform, will run on Engine.
